comment: E2E (CHANGELOG 2026-09 section 184): "$attachment_url:<document_id>" in an http_request JSON body. Seed first (see that section): a row e2e_img -> storage key e2e-checker.png for --agent-session-id e2e-url-001, the 80-byte PNG in COLMENA_LOCAL_STORAGE_DIR, and the echo on 127.0.0.1:8766. test_payload stands in for data: a body with the placeholder and an address. to_author (base_url and endpoint in its config) posts it: the echo downloads the 80 bytes from 127.0.0.1:8765/files/e2e-checker.png and `shown` logs image_url as $attachment_url:e2e_img, never the link. Then to_data_address (base_url from the payload; allowed_hosts lists it so only this rule decides) fails with 'fixes the request's address' before any request. Without the row, to_author fails with 'attachment not found'; with in-memory storage, with 'this host does not provide attachment URLs'.
